Was it because I was upset about not getting the award? If that's the case, then my action was driven by negative emotions. It's important to separate personal feelings from workplace interactions. It's important to continue being kind and supportive, even when things don't go my way. That way, I contribute positively to the team and maintain good relationships with my colleagues. So, putting it all together, not picking up the coffee because of my own feelings about the award was probably the wrong thing to do.
